The architect source-doc-reassessment step (per architect skill) caught this — without it, ~12 issues would have been re-filed for shipped work. This is the highest-value architect behavior across the session.

Plus this meta epic (#98) = 76 issues filed in this session.

### Cross-epic relations wired
- #99 (NSIDs) blocks #105 (Federation) — federation transport requires the wire format
- #123 (ML) soft-relates to #133 (Trust model) — same trust function applies to classifier signals
- #152 (TPM) soft-relates to #153 (HW token) — complementary signing-mode pair
- All eight epics related to #98 via `relate`

### Per-issue template applied (every sub-issue body)
1. Source design REQ/AC citation
2. Surface area (symbols + files, NOT raw line numbers)
3. Rust-quality notes — 3+ bullets tailored to this PR's surface (per rust-quality §1-§10 mapping)
4. External references — URLs for proto-blue, ATProto specs, RFCs, library docs
5. Acceptance — concrete verification commands tied to design ACs
6. Blocks / blocked-by — explicit chain wiring

### Open-question gates
Every epic starts with a Q-resolution sub-issue (`--kind plan`) that blocks the first PR. Provisional answers from the design docs are recorded in the epic body; human decisions become `--kind decision` comments before unblocking PR 1.

### Active /goal contract honored
"decompose the design documents into robustly documented crosslink issues whose comments guide to rust best practices and references any needed information to complete that issue" — every sub-issue body satisfies this contract:
- "Robustly documented" — typically 50-100 lines of structured guidance
- "Rust best practices" — explicit `rust-quality` §X references for the discipline that applies (error-model, async cancel-safety, unsafe-discipline, lint-clean shape, doctest expectations, etc.)
- "Information to complete" — external URLs, in-repo reference impls, proto-blue paths, lexicon URLs

### Out-of-scope for this session
- Implementation. The architect skill's hard rule: no code lands from architect-mode. Each sub-issue's prompt is intended for a future implementation agent.
- #97 NetworkPanel remains in-flight (just shipped; backend restart + live verify pending the user's smoke-handoff).
- #79 smoke-test producer-slice still open — has a `[result]` comment from 2026-05-15 noting the work landed; recommend closing on operator confirmation.
